title: Metal Crate Key
summary: Unlocks Indora Ralston’s metal crate in the Steel Watch Foundry.

fields.Lock: Metal crate at X −1972, Y 445. It contains a Potion of Supreme Healing and an Elixir of Radiant Resistance. Without the key, the lock requires DC 18 Sleight of Hand.
fields.Acquisition: Carried by Black Gauntlet Indora Ralston.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
